displayTitle: Episode I: The Phantom Menace Movie Storybook
synopsis: Episode I: The Phantom Menace Movie Storybook is a young reader book published by Random House in 1999. In their quest to protect the innocent planet of Naboo, Qui-Gon Jinn and Obi-Wan Kenobi venture to Tatooine; and Qui-Gon discovers Anakin Skywalker.
title: Episode I: The Phantom Menace Movie Storybook
